'''''Minno''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda Shuttle]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shuttle left the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Cathleen]], that was on its way to the remote world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The shuttle carrying pilots, jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] for parts unknown.
